Seven Corp on behalf of Tony and Marks Direct  

Overview: 

Tony & Mark's is a proudly family-owned South Australian business that has been providing premium fresh produce, gourmet foods, and exceptional customer service for over 46 years. With multiple retail locations across Adelaide, we are committed to sourcing the highest quality local and international products while supporting growers, suppliers, and the communities we serve. Our team is passionate about delivering an outstanding shopping experience built on quality, freshness, and service excellence.

We are currently seeking a Fruit and Veg Inspector to join the team! you will be responsible for maintaining the quality, safety, and compliance of fresh produce through inspections, food safety monitoring, and quality assurance processes. This is a full-time ongoing position, working 38 hours per week based in Cavan, SA.

Main tasks:

-	Inspect incoming fruit and vegetables for quality, freshness, grade, size, colour, and condition
-	Develop and monitor QC procedures (Freshcare SC2, HACCP, HARPS)
-	Measure and record cold chain temperatures; report deviations
-	Test samples and make accept/reject decisions
-	Ensure hygiene standards in storage, packing, dispatch, and transport
-	Identify and manage non-conforming products; coordinate corrective actions
-	Evaluate supplier performance and escalate non-conformances
-	Maintain inspection logs, temperature records, and non-conformance reports
-	Advise purchasing and warehouse teams on stock condition and availability
-	Conduct internal audits of food safety procedures
-	Liaise with suppliers, transport contractors, and internal stakeholders
-	Stay current with Australian food safety regulations and produce standards

Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Minimum of relevant Diploma, plus minimum 1 year’s relevant work experience in the last 5 years.
-	3 years’ relevant work experience may substitute the formal qualification.

Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	1 year's experience in fresh produce inspection/QC (wholesale, not retail)
-	Freshcare SC2 knowledge
-	HARPS familiarity
-	Cold chain management experience
-	HACCP knowledge
-	Strong documentation and record-keeping
-	Availability from 3:00 AM
-	Able to work in cold storage (0°C–4°C)


Annual salary will be between $75,000.00 to $85,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

result.description: Han Creek Pty Ltd   About the Role:    Han Creek Pty Ltd is seeking a full-time Multimedia Specialist to develop, produce and manage bilingual multimedia content supporting customer engagement, tourism promotion, retail sales, and business communications. The role combines multimedia design, video production, digital content development, graphic design, and customer-facing communication activities to enhance the business’s visibility among domestic and international visitors, particularly Mandarin-speaking tourists.   The successful applicant will be responsible for producing multimedia assets used across social media platforms, digital displays, websites, promotional campaigns, retail marketing materials, and customer information systems.    Salary:  AUD $85,000 - $95,000 plus superannuation    Employment Type : Full-time    Tasks and Responsibilities:     Analyse business objectives and customer engagement requirements to develop multimedia communication strategies and digital content plans.   Design, develop and produce multimedia content including videos, animations, graphics, digital displays, promotional materials and interactive customer information resources.   Create and edit short-form video content for social media platforms including TikTok, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Instagram Reels and other digital channels.   Plan, film, record and capture multimedia assets using cameras, smartphones, lighting equipment and audio devices.   Edit and integrate video, audio, graphic, photographic and text elements using multimedia production software including CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite and related applications.   Develop bilingual English and Mandarin multimedia materials, subtitles, captions, promotional graphics and customer communication resources.   Design digital and printed promotional materials including posters, brochures, souvenir artwork, point-of-sale displays and retail marketing collateral.  Produce multimedia presentations and digital screen content for in-store customer engagement and promotional campaigns.   Maintain and manage multimedia asset libraries, digital archives and content management systems to support future campaigns and business operations.  Monitor audience engagement, analyse digital platform performance data and recommend improvements to multimedia campaigns and content strategies.  Liaise with management regarding brand standards, campaign objectives and multimedia project requirements.   Research emerging multimedia technologies, digital trends and platform developments to enhance content effectiveness and audience reach.   Coordinate the production and distribution of customer information materials supporting parcel collection, mailbox services and tourist enquiries.   Ensure all multimedia content complies with business branding guidelines, copyright requirements and platform specifications.    Qualifications and Work Experience Required:     Bachelor degree in Commerce, Marketing, Information Technology, or a closely related field.   At least 5 years of relevant full-time work experience in multimedia production, digital content development, video production, graphic design or a related field.   Demonstrated experience in multimedia design, video production, filming, editing and digital content creation.   Proficiency in multimedia production software such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, Sketch, Figma, After Effects, Canva, CapCut or similar applications.   Professional working proficiency in both English and Mandarin, including reading, writing and verbal communication.   Experience creating bilingual multimedia content for customer-facing digital platforms.   Strong understanding of social media content strategies, audience engagement techniques and digital platform requirements.   Ability to manage multiple multimedia projects simultaneously and meet production deadlines.   Excellent communication, organisational and stakeholder engagement skills.     Application Process    Applicants who meet the above criteria are encouraged to apply and provide a detailed outline of their suitability for the position.   Applications will be accepted for four (4) weeks from the date of advertisement.   Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.  About Company     About the Business   Han Creek Pty Ltd is the licensed operator of Aireys Inlet Post Office, located along Victoria’s iconic Great Ocean Road. The business provides a broad range of Australia Post services to local residents, businesses, approximately 950 private mailbox holders, and a large volume of domestic and international visitors travelling through the Surf Coast and Great Ocean Road region.   In addition to traditional postal services, the business operates a retail and tourist-focused offering, supplying stationery, packaging products, souvenirs, gifts, and community services. As part of its ongoing business development strategy, Han Creek Pty Ltd has expanded its digital marketing and customer engagement initiatives to better serve its growing Mandarin-speaking visitor base and strengthen its presence across digital platforms.
